Umqeqeshi wokunyakaza

Umqeqeshi wokunyakaza ukala ukunyakaza kwakho uqhathanisa nemikhawulo esetshenziswa yi-SandFly, futhi usho amasethingi okufanele uwashintshe. Iya ku-Amasethingi, Usizo nempendulo, Umqeqeshi wokunyakaza, khetha iqembu, bese wenza ukunyakaza ngakunye izikhathi ezi-3. Kudinga i-Android 13 noma kamuva.
“Thepha kathathu” kanye no-“Thepha kane”
Ukuthepha ngomunwe owodwa noma yikuphi esikrinini. Iya ku-Amasethingi, Ukunyakaza, umunwe o-1. Azinawo umyalo ngokuzenzakalelayo futhi zidinga i-Android 13 noma kamuva.
Bamba ukuthinta entweni egxilisiwe

Lo myalo ubamba ukuthinta entweni egxilisiwe isikhathi eside nje ubambe okhiye, ezinkinobho ezifana nenkinobho yomlayezo wezwi ku-Telegram. Cindezela bese udedela okhiye ngokushesha ukuze ukuthinta kuhlale kucindezelwe uze uphinde ubacindezele. Umyalo usendaweni ethi Amasethingi, Imiyalo, Ukwenza kusebenze.
Imodi ye-BlackBerry

Ukunyakaza, okhiye nemisindo efana neye-BlackBerry 10 Screen Reader. Iya ku-Amasethingi, Amaphrofayili ezilungiselelo, Imodi ye-BlackBerry, noma usebenzise umyalo othi “Vula noma vala imodi ye-BlackBerry”.
Ukuzijwayeza ikhibhodi

I-SandFly isho ukhiye ngamunye owucindezelayo nomyalo owusebenzisayo, ngaphandle kokuwusebenzisa. Iya ku-Amasethingi, Usizo nempendulo, Ukuzijwayeza ikhibhodi, noma ucindezele Ukhiye weSandFly + K ku-Imephu yokhiye ye-VoiceOver. Cindezela labo khiye futhi, u-Emuva noma u-Escape ukuze umise.
Ukulungisa okuzenzakalelayo kanye neziphakamiso zamagama

Ikhibhodi ye-SandFly ingalungisa amagama apelwe kabi futhi ibhale uhlu lweziphakamiso zegama olithayiphayo. Umcibisholo Phezulu noMcibisholo Phansi bahamba eziphakamisweni, futhi u-Enter uthayipha esisodwa. Iya ku-Amasethingi, Ukuthayipha, Ikhibhodi engokoqobo. Kokubili kuvaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Isho izinhlamvu zephasiwedi

Nge-Ikhibhodi ye-SandFly, i-SandFly isho izinhlamvu ezithayiphwe enkambwini yephasiwedi. Iya ku-Amasethingi, Ukuthayipha, Ikhibhodi engokoqobo, Isho izinhlamvu zephasiwedi. Umyalo othi “Pela inkambu yephasiwedi”, ku-Amasethingi, Imiyalo, Ukuhlela umbhalo, upela inkambu.
Ukhiye wokuthumela
Efonini enekhibhodi, ukhiye wokuthumela ucindezela inkinobho ethi Thumela kuma-app okuthumela imilayezo.
Ukusesha okusheshayo nemodi yokubhrawuza

Kumodi yokubhrawuza, ukhiye wokusesha okusheshayo nohlamvu kuya entweni elandelayo eqala ngalolo hlamvu. Iya ku-Amasethingi, Izinqamuleli zekhibhodi, Ukusesha okusheshayo. I-Imephu yokhiye abalodwa yefoni enekhibhodi inemodi yokubhrawuza: cindezela ukhiye weSandFly kabili.
I-Braille

Amathebula amasha e-Braille: Isi-Indonesian ne-Unicode Braille. Iya ku-Amasethingi, I-Braille, Ikhibhodi ye-Braille, Izilimi, Engeza ulimi. “Gcina ikhibhodi ivulekile ngemva kokuthumela” kanye no-“Buyela kukhibhodi yangaphambilini” kusendaweni ethi Amasethingi, I-Braille, Ikhibhodi ye-Braille.
Qalisa ukuhlela ngezwi

Lo myalo uqopha imiyalo yezwi yenkambu yombhalo egxilisiwe ngokulandelana, njengokuthi “khetha konke”, “kopisha”, noma “thayipha” nombhalo. Yisho ukuthi “misa ukuhlela” ukuze uqede. Umyalo usendaweni ethi Amasethingi, Imiyalo, Ukuhlela umbhalo.
Imiyalo yezwi yombhalo

Hambisa ikhesa, khetha, kopisha, sika futhi ususe ngezinhlamvu, amagama, imisho, imigqa noma izigaba, njengokuthi “susa amagama amahlanu alandelayo” noma “ekugcineni komugqa”. Imishwana ikhona ku-Umhlahlandlela womsebenzisi, Isijobelelo C.
Umugqa omusha, Umusho olandelayo kanye no-Umusho odlule
Umugqa omusha uthayipha umugqa omusha, noma wenza isenzo senkambu yomugqa owodwa. Umusho olandelayo nomusho odlule kusendaweni ethi Amasethingi, Imiyalo, Zulazula ngombhalo.
Ukhiye wokuthulisa
Kumafoni anokhiye wokuthulisa, njenge-Zinwa Q25, bamba ukhiye wokuthulisa enkambwini yombhalo ukuze ubhale ngezwi. Iya ku-Amasethingi, Okhiye bevolumu.
“Phendula ucingo” kanye no-“Qeda ikholi”
Yomibili imiyalo isebenza nasezingcingweni zama-app afana ne-WhatsApp. Qeda ikholi yenqaba noma iqede ucingo. Imiyalo isendaweni ethi Amasethingi, Imiyalo, Izenzo zesistimu.
Amathayela ama-app kanye namathayela esistimu
Izigaba zemiyalo ezenza amathayela amasethingi asheshayo asebenze. Iya ku-Amasethingi, Imiyalo.
Sesha imiyalo

Inkambu yokusesha phezulu ku-Amasethingi, Imiyalo ibhala uhlu lwemiyalo efana namagama owathayiphayo. Isikrini somyalo ngamunye sino-“Yenza ukunyakaza”, “Qalisa umyalo” no-“Engeza kumenyu ye-SandFly”.
Usizo
Usizo, kubha ye-app yezikrini zamasethingi, luvula ingxenye yomhlahlandlela womsebenzisi emayelana nesikrini.
Ikhodi yeskripthi
Ekhasini leskripthi, u-“Buka ikhodi” ubonisa ikhodi futhi u-“Hlela ikhodi” uyayishintsha. Ukuze ufake iskripthi kusuka kukhodi, iya ku-Amasethingi, Iziskripthi, Iskripthi esisha kusuka kukhodi.
Isilawuli sokufunda Isevisi ye-AI
Swayipha phezulu noma phansi ukuze ushintshe phakathi kwamasevisi e-AI asethiwe. Kwengeze ku-Amasethingi, Izilawuli zokufunda.
Izenzo ziyatholakala
Kudlala umsindo wezinto ezinezenzo ezengeziwe, njengokuthi Phendula emlayezweni wengxoxo. Iya ku-Amasethingi, Umsindo nokudlidliza, Umsindo wokuthi Izenzo ziyatholakala.
Amatimu omsindo

Ukuze ushintshe umsindo, u-“Khetha kufolda” ubhala uhlu lwamafayela omsindo efolda futhi udlale ifayela eligxilisiwe. Umsindo we-3D unokuthi “Ngama-headphone, maphakathi uma kungenjalo”. Iya ku-Amasethingi, Umsindo nokudlidliza, Amatimu omsindo.
Isinyathelo sesivinini senkulumo kanye no-“Dlala isampula”

Isinyathelo sesivinini senkulumo sisetha ukuthi isivinini senkulumo sishintsha kangakanani ngesikhathi esisodwa. Iya ku-Amasethingi, Inkulumo, Isinyathelo sesivinini senkulumo. Iphrofayili yezwi ngayinye ino-“Dlala isampula”.
Khuluma ngenkathi imidiya idlala
Isho izimemezelo zokuvalwa kwesikrini nezokuvula ukhiye ngenkathi imidiya idlala. Iya ku-Amasethingi, I-Verbosity, Ukuvula nokuvala isikrini.
Ukutholwa kwemibala kanye neThoni yezinga lokukhanya
Ukubona bukhoma kusho imibala esemaphakathi nokubukwa kwekhamera, noma kudlale ithoni ephakama njengoba ukukhanya kukhula. Iya ku-Amasethingi, Izincazelo zezithombe nezesikrini, Ukubona bukhoma.
Ukubona umbhalo weCyrillic
Ukubona umbhalo kufunda isi-Russian, isi-Ukrainian nezinye izilimi ezibhalwe ngeCyrillic, ngemodeli oyilandayo. Iya ku-Amasethingi, Izincazelo zezithombe nezesikrini, Ukubona umbhalo weCyrillic.
